_comment: Verified live sources (checked 2026-08-01 against the ArcGIS services). parcels = LA County 2022 assessment roll polygons (2.42M county-wide). parcels_usecode = 2025 parcel view, attributes only, for current 4-char use codes (vacancy detection). Overlays: LA City zoning + hillside, statewide coastal zone + fire hazard severity (bbox-limited).

parcels_ventura.name: Ventura County Parcels (hosted snapshot, ~2018 vintage; county's live server is not reachable from this network)

parcels_sb.name: Santa Barbara County Assessor Parcels Public (official, current)

parcels_usecode.name: LA County Assessor Parcels 2025 (use codes only, attributes-only download)

city_boundary.name: Los Angeles City Boundary (LA Dept of City Planning)

hillside.name: Hillside Ordinance (City of LA Hub, via opendata mirror)

vhfhsz.name: CAL FIRE FHSZ in LRA, adopted 2025 (statewide, bbox-limited)

vhfhsz_sra.name: CAL FIRE FHSZ in SRA, effective 4/1/2024 (statewide, bbox-limited)

vacancy._comment: Vacant if the 2025 use code ends in V / is in vacant_use_codes, OR use_type says vacant, OR improvements are negligible both absolutely (< improvement_value_max) and relative to land value (< improvement_land_ratio_max * land) - the ratio guard avoids Prop-13 low-assessment false positives.

sb1123._comment: Thresholds in sqft. SF: 1.5 ac (SB 1123 vacant single-family lots). MF: 5 ac (SB 684 multifamily-zoned lots). Fire: High(1) and Very High(2) both disqualify.

subsets._comment: A subset is one bbox [minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat] or a list of bboxes (downloaded sequentially; 02_enrich dedupes parcels by AIN where boxes overlap).

tiers._comment: Market tiers baked into each parcel as attribute 't'. Each tier is a list of bboxes [minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat]; a parcel gets the first tier (A, then B, then C) whose box contains it, so overlaps resolve to the better tier. Rough approximations of submarket boundaries - tune freely. A: Westside. B: south Valley / Ventura corridor (Woodland Hills, Tarzana, Encino, Sherman Oaks, Studio City) + West Hills. C: central & north Valley (Canoga Park, Reseda, Northridge, Chatsworth, Granada Hills, North Hills, Panorama City, Van Nuys, North Hollywood, Pacoima, Sylmar).
